messages.subject: Project Falcon - COMPLETED
messages.plaintextBody:
Gregory, Sarah,

I'm pleased to confirm that Project Falcon completed this afternoon. The SPA is executed, the shares in Wren & Hartley are transferred to Falcon Bidco, completion monies of £42.6m have been paid to the sellers' solicitors and £2.0m is held in escrow. Board minutes signed, resignations effective. Congratulations to all.

We'll deal with stamping and Companies House filings next week.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
